ms.report:
We appreciate the feedback from PoA4. Based on your input, we've made the following updates: 
Revised Report
View report 
・A new section outlines our process for documenting meetings with investors and mentors.
・We introduced teams to approximately 20 strategic connections during the program and equipped them with the skills to continue expanding their networks--through cohort-led events and participation in high-value opportunities such as the Draper Venture Summit.

 Updated Spreadsheet Submission
View spreadsheet 
・Tab 1: Program Modules -- Column C now includes links to all workshop materials we've received consent to share publicly.
・Tab 3: Connections (new) -- This tab outlines the high-value mentors and investors founders had access to throughout the program:
・18 were mentors who delivered sessions as part of the core program.
・22 were invited by the cohort through self-organized networking events in the Bay Area.
・~70 were potential connections available during the Draper Venture Summit--a private, invite-only event hosted by Tim Draper for his network of VCs, portfolio companies, and global business partners.
・While not every founder may have engaged with all individuals listed--due to the scale of the Summit--those who participated proactively were able to make valuable connections, often supported by program leads such as Arisa (Program Manager) and Samiz (Draper Dragon).

 Please let us know if any additional clarification is needed.
